morphology.formula: hear → heard（英语不规则过去式及过去分词）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入包将 heard 标为词根，但英语词元实际为 hear。这里按英语屈折关系纠正；heard 不是马来语派生词，其末尾也不是可独立切分的马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 英语 hear 的过去式或过去分词：听见、听到声音。
senses.en_definition: Past tense and past participle of hear: perceived sound through the ears.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk lampau dan partisipel lampau kata kerja Inggeris hear; bermaksud mendengar atau terdengar sesuatu bunyi.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词形，不应标为正式马来语词。马来语依语境用 mendengar 或 terdengar，并用时间状语或 sudah 等表达时间、完成意义。下列 ms 搭配提供马来语对应表达；马来语释义为编写说明。[Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/hear)

senses.zh_definition: 听说、获悉消息；也用于表示听闻某人或某事。
senses.en_definition: Learned information or became aware of someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Mendapat tahu sesuatu berita atau pernah mengetahui tentang seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: heard that 后接所获悉的信息；heard about 侧重听到相关消息，heard of 常表示知道其存在。不能逐字把这些英语介词结构套入马来语。[Cambridge 英语词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/hear)

senses.zh_definition: 听取陈述、申诉或证言；在司法语境中指审理案件。
senses.en_definition: Listened to statements or testimony, or considered a case in legal proceedings.
senses.ms_definition: Mendengar keterangan, aduan atau hujah; dalam konteks kehakiman, membicarakan sesuatu kes.
senses.nuances: 此义包含有目的地听取或审议，不只是感官上听见。案件可译为 membicarakan kes，证言可译为 mendengar keterangan。[Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hear)

senses.zh_definition: 与 from 连用，表示收到某人的消息或联系。
senses.en_definition: Received a message or other communication from someone.
senses.ms_definition: Menerima khabar atau mendapat maklum balas daripada seseorang.
senses.nuances: heard from 不限于听觉，也可指收到邮件、短信或其他联系；与 heard of 的意思不同。[Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/hear)

collocations.ms: belum mendapat maklum balas daripada mereka
collocations.zh: 还没有收到他们的回复

dual_scenarios.context: 职场英语培训 / 词形说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan berbahasa Inggeris itu, perkataan heard digunakan sebagai bentuk lampau bagi hear.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在那份英文报告中，heard 用作 hear 的过去式。
dual_scenarios.en: In that English-language report, heard is used as the past tense of hear.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论英文消息
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia tulis 'heard' dalam mesej tu; maksudnya dia dah dengar, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dia menulis 'heard' dalam mesej itu; maksudnya dia sudah mendengar, betul?
dual_scenarios.zh: 他在那条消息里写了 heard，就是说他已经听到了，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: He wrote 'heard' in that message, so he means he has already heard it, right?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式
dah 是 sudah 的口语形式
heard 作为被讨论的英语词出现

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dia tulis 'I've heard the news' kat WhatsApp. Dia dah tahu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Dia menulis 'I've heard the news' di WhatsApp. Adakah dia sudah mengetahui berita itu?
messages.zh: 他在 WhatsApp 写了 I've heard the news。他已经知道了吗？
messages.en: He wrote 'I've heard the news' on WhatsApp. Does that mean he already knows?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, dia dah dengar berita tu. Tak payah beritahu lagi lah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah mendengar berita itu. Tidak perlu memberitahunya lagi.
messages.zh: 对，他已经听说了，不用再告诉他啦。
messages.en: Yes, he has already heard about it. No need to tell him again.

etymology.historical_story: Heard belongs to the English verb hear, whose history reaches back through Middle English to Old English hīeran. Its modern past form differs noticeably from the present form in both spelling and pronunciation. For a Malay learner, the useful distinction is grammatical: English changes the verb form, while Malay normally expresses the relevant time through context or accompanying words. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hear)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hear → heard 成对记：耳朵已经接收了声音。heard 与英语 herd 同音，不按 hear 加一个独立的 d 来读。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 英语交流中 heard 是中性词。完整的正式马来语表达应根据语境使用 mendengar、terdengar 或 menerima khabar。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 日常双语聊天可以引用 heard；马来语公文中应使用适当的马来语表达。输入排名仅作为所给数据集的排名保留，不代表正式马来语词频。
